meta.name: Maigret
meta.description: Jules Maigret is a rising star in the Police Judiciaire, relentless in his investigations, with an uncanny ability to get under the skin of the criminals he is chasing and a matchless knowledge of Paris and its inhabitants
meta.country: United Kingdom, Germany, United States of America

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: Maigret investigates Paris bank robberies. He turns his attention to the murder of a burglar, Honoré Cuendet, until the robbers strike again.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: Maigret anticipates the robbers' next move and gets the chance to confront Cuendet's killers. But, the robbers have a larger master plan.

videos.title: Maigret's Failure (1)
videos.overview: The team is interrupted when Maigret is ordered to investigate death threats received by a billionaire businessman, Ferdinand Fumal.

videos.title: Maigret's Failure (2)
videos.overview: As Maigret reels from regret, he suffers a blow in his personal life. Maigret digs into Fumal's life in order to understand him better.

videos.title: Maigret Comes Home (1)
videos.overview: A student is stabbed to death in the street. Maigret digs into the killer's psychology. Countess Sophie calls, fearing for her life.

videos.title: Maigret Comes Home (2)
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes in Saint-Fiacre as Maigret digs into secrets. Back in Paris, Maigret's talks with the killer have terrifying consequences.

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: Maigret investigates young woman's death, crossing paths with those hiding the truth.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: Maigret learns Adeline's death was only the latest of three violent deaths.

videos.title: "Maigret's Revolver" (1)
videos.overview: Maigret investigates both a young woman's drowning and a congressman's disappearance.

videos.title: "Maigret's Revolver" (2)
videos.overview: Maigret chases killers for two of his cases, but uncovering the truth puts him in more danger than he anticipated.

videos.title: "The Yellow Dog" (1)
videos.overview: After a businessman is killed, Maigret trusts his instincts despite pressure from his superiors.

videos.title: "The Yellow Dog" (2)
videos.overview: Facing suspicion from superiors and team, Maigret's reputation is on the line.
